entry.title: A basket of things to explore
entry.summary: For a baby who gets into sitting independently, the authors describe a discovery basket of a few varied objects, each suitable for grasping and mouthing with all parts secure.
entry.cue: Sitting leaves your baby’s hands free, and they are interested in choosing and examining objects.
detail: Their examples include a small group of kitchen objects with different shapes or textures. The baby chooses what to examine; an occasional name can fit without interrupting every discovery.
A separate appendix example uses two or three familiar toys in a soft basket while the baby lies or sits. That simpler choice is distinct from propping a baby to use a seated discovery basket.
